title: Oyatie Cloud enforceability facets for authorization, tenancy, audit, metering, and billing
purpose: Binds every G002 resource contract to metadata-level Cedar decision fields, tenant/account/project scope, audit-chain fields, fail-closed quota/cost admission, and oya-meter/oya-billing integration points before later runtime evidence work.

can_claim_now: Oyatie Cloud has proposed enforceability metadata bindings for every G002 resource contract.
Every binding includes Cedar decision metadata, tenant/account/project scope, audit-chain fields, fail-closed quota admission, and oya-meter/oya-billing integration points.

cedar_policy.policy_template: permit only when tenant/account/project, principal action, resource ORN, region/cell, quota, and operation intent all match an allowed policy snapshot

tenant_scope.immutability: tenant/account/project scope is immutable after create acceptance unless a later migration operation is explicitly modeled

audit.chain: audit_chain_id must connect admission decision, registry generation, operation transition, and billing/metering records
audit.retention: inherits resource deletion_retention policy and jurisdiction pack where applicable

quota_cost.overage_behavior: deny operation before ledger acceptance and emit audit reason code

resource_enforceability.honest_claim: Policy, tenancy, audit, metering, and billing metadata bindings exist for validation; runtime engines and workload migration are not claimed here.

nonclaims.statement: Policy decision fields and templates are metadata bindings; runtime policy evaluation remains later work.
Billing and metering fields are integration bindings; rated invoicing execution remains later work.
Audit-chain fields are metadata bindings; pipeline execution remains later work.
Tenant migration remains blocked until substrate, policy, observability, and CI evidence are complete.

doubt_driven_review.challenge: Enforceability metadata can be misread as running policy, audit, metering, or billing engines.
doubt_driven_review.resolution: Every row and integration point is metadata/integration-point only; validator rejects default-allow policy, missing tenant scope, non-fail-closed quotas, runtime claims, and missing resource rows.
doubt_driven_review.residual_risk: G005-G007 must still add measured observability/SLO, quality-kit, and dogfood CI evidence before launch language is safe.
